entities.summary: USS William D. Porter (DD-579) was a Fletcher-class destroyer of the United States Navy, named for Commodore William D. Porter (1808–1864), during World War II. She served in the Atlantic and Pacific theaters, the latter where she was sunk by a kamikaze.
